info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_OAuth URL Generation API
info.description: The OAuth URL Generation API facilitates the creation of OAuth URLs for specified financial institutions. This endpoint enables applications to generate secure authentication links, enhancing user experience during login or data sharing. Typically, developers integrating financial services leverage this API to streamline the authorization process, ensuring seamless access to institutional resources. The API requires the institutionId to personalize the OAuth URL for specific institutional settings.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of an OAuth URL for the specified institution, enabling secure authentication and authorization for users. This facilitates the integration of third-party services with the institution's platform.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or generate OAuth URLs for the specified institution. The data provided will define the parameters necessary for OAuth authentication, allowing for secure access and user authorization.
